client: Frissa International Nursery and Primary School Limited
headline: A nursery and primary school needed systems that support enrolment and keep parents satisfied.
challenge: A school has to meet its regulatory duties while handling admissions, staff, parents and fees. Informal processes quickly slow enrolment and leave parents unsure who to ask.
delivered: Employment documentation, school admission and parent and school agreements
Customer care systems, digital marketing and operational support
impact: A school with clearer enrolment processes, better communication with parents and the foundations for steady growth.
